name: Cacnea
normal: green body, yellow-orange flower on head, dark eye mask
shiny: green body turns brown (dried-cactus look); flower stays
note: ShinyRating lists brown as the shiny's main color; Bulbapedia returned 403 and has image-only shiny info. Original draft (yellower green) was wrong.

name: Finneon
normal: blue-teal body, pink-red fins and tail
shiny: blue body and dark blue fins turn brown; pink parts stay
note: ShinyRating main color brown; a Pokemon GO article says yellow-brown body, brown fins. Draft (green-teal) was wrong.

name: Yanmega
normal: green body, red eyes, grey-blue wings
shiny: green body turns cobalt blue with magenta accents
note: Reviewers describe blue body with magenta accents; accents are likely the eyes (Eye textures skipped), so no red rule. Draft hue target 275 changed to 262.

name: Liepard
normal: purple-violet fur, yellow eyes/markings, dark tail tip
shiny: purple fur turns brown/dark red-brown; yellow markings stay
note: ShinyRating main color brown (reviewers: brown, dark red). Draft (blue-lilac) was wrong.

name: Stunfisk
normal: salmon-orange body, yellow fin ring and spots, dark brown edge
shiny: body turns pale cream-yellow; yellow fin ring and spots turn light blue; dark brown edge stays
desc: orange body goes cream, yellow fins go blue
note: Re-measured HOME sprites, pixel-aligned. Body hue 30-40 (C0.125,L0.75) -> ~88 (C0.097,L0.92); fin ring/spots hue 90-110 (C0.15-0.2) -> ~205-213 (C0.10). Dark brown edge (near-grey, hue ~53, L0.45-0.7) darkens slightly in the shiny but is kept (grey rules cannot scale lightness). Windows narrowed to the measured hues so the brown edge is not caught. Simulated mean OKLab error vs real shiny 0.033 (unrecolored 0.161).

name: Mandibuzz
normal: grey-brown plumage, pale yellow chest, cream skirt, pink face, orange-tan beak/talons
shiny: plumage darker with reddish-brown tint, chest turns lavender-purple, skirt turns white, light grey wing feathers orange-brown, pink face stronger
desc: yellow chest turns lavender, skirt white, light wings orange-brown
note: Re-measured. Chest hue 70-93 (C0.068) -> ~319-326 (C x0.89). Skirt hue 93-110 (C0.076) loses chroma (x0.24) to near-white. Pink face hue 350-20 C x1.85. Grey plumage (C~0.02) at L0.3-0.58 stays grey (tiny warm tint); lighter grey (L0.6-0.9) becomes orange-brown hue ~58 C~0.07 (89% of those texels). Shiny plumage is also darker (L x0.8), which the grey rule cannot express, so the body will look lighter than the sprite. Simulated mean error 0.077 vs 0.099 unrecolored; the rest is lightness.

name: Primarina
normal: deep blue body, aqua hair, white and lavender ruffle, pink-lavender pearls
shiny: aqua hair turns pale yellow, blue body goes more violet and less saturated, ruffle near-white
note: Re-measured. Hair hue 200-210 (C0.097,L0.84) -> ~108 (C0.092,L0.95). Blue body hue 250-260 (C0.13,L0.67) -> ~269 (C x0.72); dark body texels keep their lightness (the earlier L x0.85 made it too dark), so no light scale. Pale lavender highlights (C0.04-0.09, L0.7-0.9) go near-neutral warm white in the shiny; the grey rule covers only the C<0.06 ones. Simulated mean error 0.032 vs 0.077 unrecolored.

name: Crabrawler
normal: blue gloves, purple body and legs, cream spike
shiny: gloves turn red-orange; purple body stays purple, a little lighter; cream spike slightly more yellow-orange
note: Re-measured, confirmed. Blue gloves hue 200-240 (C0.13-0.15,L0.7-0.83) -> ~30 (C0.19-0.2, L x0.87). Purple body ~307 (C0.16) -> ~310 (C0.12, L x1.18). Cream ~104 -> ~72. Simulated mean error 0.017 vs 0.218 unrecolored.

name: Lycanroc
normal: pinkish-tan fur, white mane and tail, dark brown claws
shiny: tan fur turns blue (darker), white mane stays; dark parts stay
note: Re-measured Midday form. Fur hue 40-60 with C only ~0.04 (mostly near-grey) -> hue ~260-277, C ~0.05-0.06, L x0.78 (darker). Grey rule used because hue rules need C>=0.04 and grey rules cannot scale lightness, so part of the darkening is lost. White mane (L>0.87) and dark claws unchanged. Eyes (blue to yellow-green) not encoded. Other forms may differ. Simulated mean error 0.015 vs 0.077 unrecolored.

name: Comfey
normal: lime-green head and stem, orange-yellow face, orange, yellow, pink and grey flowers
shiny: lime head turns light blue, orange-yellow face turns pale blue-white; all flowers unchanged
desc: head and face turn light blue
note: Re-measured. Head hue 109-125 (C0.12,L0.87) -> ~235 (C0.075,L0.73). Face hue 84-96 (C0.17) -> pale blue-white (C x0.2). Yellow flowers (hue 96-108, C0.17) and pink/orange/grey flowers stay (orange flowers lose a little chroma, ignored). Face window narrowed from 75+-15 to 90+-6 so it cannot reach the yellow flowers. Hue window edges are hard in the builder (no feather on the high side), so windows are exact. Simulated mean error 0.023 vs 0.066 unrecolored.

name: Pyukumuku
normal: dark grey-teal top, white underside, pink-red hands and tips
shiny: dark top turns green; pink-red hands turn yellow-olive
desc: dark body turns green, pink tips turn yellow
note: Re-measured. Dark body L0.3-0.55, C~0.015 (near-grey) -> hue ~150, C0.10-0.15 and L rises a lot (x1.75, to 0.64-0.76); the grey rule cannot lift lightness, so the body will be a darker green than the sprite. Pink hands hue 330-360 (C0.2,L0.64) -> ~88 (C0.12, L x1.25). White unchanged. Lower grey chroma (0.06-0.11) scored worse than 0.125. Simulated mean error 0.206 vs 0.298 unrecolored (remaining error is lightness), so confidence is medium.

name: Jolteon
note: ShinyRating main color green; reviewers say lime green and a green bolt. Draft (golden-orange) was wrong.

name: Blastoise
normal: blue skin, brown shell, white-cream belly, grey cannons
shiny: blue skin turns purple; brown shell turns green
desc: blue skin turns purple, shell green
note: ShinyRating main color purple; reviewers note a green shell. Draft (teal-green skin, unchanged shell) was wrong. Shell window kept narrow so cream belly is not caught.

name: Raichu
normal: orange fur, cream belly, brown back stripes, yellow cheek pads
shiny: orange fur turns a redder orange
note: Reviewers: more reddish orange, sunburnt look. Draft (golden yellow) was the wrong direction.

name: Machamp
normal: grey-blue skin, red-brown belt and wrist bands
note: ShinyRating main color green. Draft (blue-lilac) was wrong. Skin may be near-grey or slightly blue, so both rule types are given.

name: Meganium
normal: green body, red-pink flower collar and petals, yellow belly and white
shiny: green becomes yellow-green, red-pink collar turns orange-yellow, white unchanged
desc: collar turns orange-yellow, green goes yellow-green
note: Re-measured, confirmed. Red-pink collar hue 342-26 (C0.21,L0.68), 27% of pixels, -> ~59 (C0.157,L0.77); pink flower bits ~345-355 -> ~64-69. Green ~128 (C0.15-0.17) -> ~110, chroma kept, L x1.05. Yellow ~100-110 unchanged. Simulated mean error 0.013 vs 0.096 unrecolored.

name: Hoothoot
normal: brown-tan feathers, cream belly, red eyes
note: ShinyRating main colors gold and yellow, a noticeable shift from brown. Draft (redder brown) was wrong. Eyes are skipped.

name: Murkrow
normal: dark navy-black plumage, yellow-cream beak and feet, red gem
shiny: dark plumage turns magenta-pink and much lighter; yellow parts stay
note: Re-measured, confirmed. Navy plumage hue 240-260 (C0.10,L0.28-0.39, 83% of the sprite) -> ~327 (C0.14-0.175,L0.48-0.66). Beak/feet hue 80-110 unchanged. Simulated mean error 0.012 vs 0.242 unrecolored.

name: Corsola
normal: pink coral body, white-cream tips, dark eyes
note: ShinyRating main color blue. Target hue moved from 215 to 250.
